videos.author: @aslidramaybaaz
videos.description: Dastoor Episode 56 💔⚡ Hospital mein Zulfiqar aur Shiza ki achanak mulaqat par Mustafa ne ghalat-fahmi aur shaq ki aag mein aakar azeem tamasha khada kar diya, jiski shiddat Shiza ka kamzor wajood bardasht na kar saka aur be-hosh hokar gir padi!
